environment: Owner Mac (macOS 25.6.0 arm64, node 26.8.2). The extractor reads only an immutable snapshot; no live service, provider or production database is touched.

commands.action: Extract the strict raw-plus-parsed model from the live production snapshot under a fixed clock
Repeat the extraction and compare the canonical models byte-for-byte

assertions: The reader opens exactly one read-only SQLite handle and performs no provider call, HTTP request, wall-clock read or randomness; a missing capture clock is refused rather than defaulted.
No store or authority constructor is reachable from the reader's require graph, so no time-sensitive season rollover, default minting or random id generation can occur during extraction.
Duplicate JSON object keys are refused before any value can be overwritten, while legitimate __proto__/constructor/prototype data keys are preserved as own enumerable properties.
Opaque TEXT metadata may legitimately carry a large legacy integral value while classified money and counters stay strictly safe-integer.
A quarter boundary is not rolled: a stale stored season is reported as a delta, never written, and the raw bytes stay authoritative.
Non-UUID and legacy text actor ids, linked providers and bought-Crown reservations survive verbatim.
Every table and every one of the 37,409 classified fields is accounted for on the real live source: 0 unclassified, 0 accepted-unknown, 0 grammar drift.
Repeated extraction of the same snapshot under the same clock produces a byte-identical canonical model.

not_claimed: G03 acceptance or any import/reconciliation behaviour
sanitized_summary: The pure extraction layer reads an immutable snapshot with one read-only handle and no constructor, provider call, wall-clock or randomness. On the real live production snapshot it classified all 37,409 fields with zero unclassified and zero accepted entries, reported zero grammar drift, and produced a byte-identical canonical model on repeat. The source-side behaviour suites pass 20/20 with zero skips.
review_notes: No value from the source is reproduced in this record; only counts, hashes and structural facts.
